doc.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing thanks
summary: Brown thanks Golson on behalf of the Smithsonian; Golson thanks him in German and the transcription credit follows.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Benny Golson, you are my hero, and I’m so glad to have been able to have conducted this interview. So I just want to say – unless you have anything else to add – and it’s never too late – I just want to say on behalf of the Smithsonian Institution, on behalf of Ken Kimery and myself, Anthony Brown, we are just so privileged, honored to have been able to be here, to have you share your life and music with us.
Vielendank. Das ist alles. [Many thanks. That’s all.]
